title: Just Closed | 2517 Windy Vane Dr, Pflugerville, TX 78660
description:
Dear Nigel and Teri,

I have only seen two people in love and in sync a few times at closing. It's been a pleasure being on your team in finding your beautiful home, that in just a few short weeks you will make it your dream home. Your kids are blessed to not just have you supply them with their needs, but the love you show even just talking about them. I pray for you all the happiness in the world, and I cannot wait to see all the memories you build in your new home. 🤗💖

Hugs friends,
Gloria Miller
